description: This file defines a PHP class LoggerSubscriber which subscribes to exception events in a Symfony-based application. It logs error messages and stack traces whenever an exception occurs.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for exception events and logs the exception message and stack trace.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array configuring the class to listen to kernel exception events.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles an exception event, retrieving the exception details and logging them.
